importantSnapshotWarning: The ZIP does not contain a complete November 9, 2026 snapshot. It contains only page 1 (2,000 rows) whose header says count=12,404 and pages=7, plus pages 2–7 of a separate November 10, 2026 snapshot whose header says count=12,629. Do not combine these into a claim that all 12,404 November 9 rows were supplied.
reconciliation: Exact stable IDs are grouped into one catalogue record with separate dated source versions in snapshots[]. This is record-level reconciliation; conflicting source values remain preserved in each snapshot entry. No fuzzy-name matching was used.
sourceUrlCaveat: MCPTOP URL patterns are inferred from the PDF filenames and embedded page numbering; the exact URL was not independently verified from a live API. Each page record carries this status.

openAppsNovember8.status: not supplied in Podcasts.zip and not found in the available Library search
openAppsNovember8.taxonomyNote: The user-described six families and thirteen categories are taxonomy summaries only; they are not treated as individual records and are not substituted with MCPTOP rows.

recordFieldQuality.name: Source-supplied when extracted; missing/damaged names left null.
recordFieldQuality.publisher: Source-supplied author.name when present; missing/damaged values left null.
recordFieldQuality.description: MCPTOP oneLiner only; no expanded descriptions supplied.
recordFieldQuality.icon: Source icon URL when supplied; ownership and fetch availability not independently verified.
recordFieldQuality.functions: Not supplied / not verified in the PDFs.
recordFieldQuality.toolsActions: toolCount source field retained (0 for all supplied records); individual tool/action definitions not supplied.
recordFieldQuality.apis: Not supplied / not verified. directoryUrl is a directory listing URL, not an API endpoint.
recordFieldQuality.verification: isVerified is null for all supplied row occurrences; therefore records are not marked verified.
recordFieldQuality.officialIcon: Source-provided icon URL only; official ownership and live fetch are not independently verified.

familyMapping: Nexa family tags are inferred locally from MCPTOP categories, names, slugs and oneLiner descriptions; not official MCPTOP labels. The original source categories are retained independently.

activityStatusLibrary.status: generated-proposed-draft; original 422-item source wording not supplied
activityStatusLibrary.note: The previously referenced original 422-item vocabulary was not present in the supplied ZIP or located by available Library search. This is a newly drafted 422-item substitute (34 milestone messages for each of 12 families plus 14 cross-family statuses), not a claim that the original wording was preserved.

snapshotReconciliationDetails: Each unique stable record retains all exact-ID snapshot versions, including the full extracted sourceRecordFields object for each occurrence.
